objective: Verify exact represented-system residual decisions for dense and CSR complex inputs, including cancellation, duplicate CSR entries, threshold neighborhoods, zero reference, malformed/nonfinite inputs, and explicit resource limits.

method.input_values: Stored float32/float64 and complex64/complex128 binary values converted to exact rational components.
method.normalized_residual: ||A*x-b||2 / max(||b||2, ||A*x||2), with exact squared norms and exact comparison against the square of binary64(1e-7).
method.sparse_handling: CSR only; no format conversion and no floating-point sum_duplicates. Duplicate entries are summed as exact stored terms.
method.scope_limit: This validates the offline exact evaluator, not the production sparse matvec roundoff bound, assembly, physics, or forward solution error.

criteria.pass: All nine exact nodeids pass individually; dense/CSR exact decisions agree where their represented matrices agree; duplicate CSR storage remains unchanged; unsupported formats, invalid values, and exceeded budgets return INCONCLUSIVE.
criteria.fail: Any assertion failure or uncaught exception.
criteria.historical_status: Do not edit or promote J14/J15/J16/J17 historical outcomes.

execution.commands: One pytest invocation per exact nodeid; no directory or suite target.
